description: This file defines React components and hooks related to user onboarding and quiz prerequisites. It includes a guard mechanism to ensure users complete onboarding and/or quizzes before accessing certain pages, along with a reusable inline alert component.

methods.name: InlineAlert
methods.description: React component rendering a styled inline alert box with title, optional description, and actions.

methods.name: useClientGuard
methods.description: Custom React hook that checks user onboarding and quiz completion status, returning a boolean indicating if requirements are met and a JSX element for notices.
